topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: A New Student in the Art Room
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定的字数。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage: This is a small art room. There is a big table in the middle. There are six chairs around the table. A new student is in the room. Her name is Lily. She is standing near the window. She is holding a red pencil. The teacher is at the door. She is smiling. There is a box on the table. The box is open. There are many pencils in the box. Lily is drawing a picture. The picture is on the table. There is a clock on the wall. The clock is above the door. It is three o'clock. Lily is happy. She likes the art room.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，房间里有什么？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“There is a big table in the middle.”，所以房间里有一张大桌子。
questions.evidence: There is a big table in the middle.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，桌子周围有几把椅子？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are six chairs around the table.”，所以是六把椅子。
questions.evidence: There are six chairs around the table.

questions.explanation: 短文说“She is standing near the window.”，所以Lily站在窗户附近。
questions.evidence: She is standing near the window.

questions.explanation: 短文说“She is holding a red pencil.”，所以Lily拿着一支红铅笔。
questions.evidence: She is holding a red pencil.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，盒子里有什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are many pencils in the box.”，所以盒子里有许多铅笔。
questions.evidence: There are many pencils in the box.

questions.explanation: 短文说“The clock is above the door.”，所以时钟在门上方。
questions.evidence: The clock is above the door.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，Lily正在画什么？请用原文中的一个词填空：Lily is drawing a ______.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lily is drawing a picture.”，所以填picture。

questions.prompt: 根据短文，现在几点？请用原文中的两个词填空：It is ______ ______.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is three o'clock.”，所以填three o'clock。

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 我们用 there is 表示“有一个”，后面接单数名词；用 there are 表示“有多个”，后面接复数名词。地点介词如 in（在……里）、on（在……上）、near（在……附近）、above（在……上方）告诉我们东西在哪里。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是 am/is/are + 动词-ing，比如 is standing（正在站）。祈使句用来发出指令，比如 Open the door.（打开门。）
grammar.example: There is a big table in the middle. There are six chairs around the table. She is standing near the window. The clock is above the door.

options: There is a book on the desk.
There are a book on the desk.
There is books on the desk.
There are book on the desk.
answers: There is a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: book是单数，所以用 There is。
questions.evidence: There is a big table in the middle.

options: The cat is under the table.
The cat under the table is.
answers: The cat is under the table.
questions.explanation: 地点介词短语 under the table 放在句末。
questions.evidence: There is a box on the table.

questions.explanation: 现在进行时结构是 is + 动词-ing。
questions.evidence: She is holding a red pencil.

questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，省略主语 you。
questions.evidence: She is standing near the window.
